description: InfiniteRunner_XAU V2 demo execution (ADR 0005, defaults per ADR 0006): execution enabled by default so the runner trades on demo immediately. One runner position toward a far mandatory safety TP with a monotonic break-even/trailing SL anchored to the stored initial R; decisions on closed bars (H1/M15/M5 or legacy EMA parity). Demo account or Strategy Tester only; real accounts are rejected at OnInit. Set InpEnableExecution=false for a dry-run comparison.

assumptions.account: demo or Strategy Tester only; real/contest accounts are rejected at OnInit (ExecContextAllowed -> INIT_FAILED)
assumptions.position_model: at most one runner position filtered by symbol and InpMagicNumber; adopted on restart with break-even disabled if initial R is unknown
assumptions.direction: InpDirectionMode 1 = H1 context + M15 confirmation + M5 pullback-reclaim on closed bars; 0 = legacy EMA parity for A/B comparison; NO_TRADE/REVERSAL_WATCH are valid outcomes
assumptions.stops: initial SL inside [InpMinStopPoints, InpMaxStopPoints], tick-normalized, broker stop level respected; far safety TP InpSafetyTpPoints is mandatory on every order (ADR 0004)
assumptions.trailing: break-even from the stored initial R then monotonic trailing (BUY SL only rises, SELL SL only falls): fixed distance or ATR multiple; candidates that violate the band or broker level are refused, never clamped
assumptions.sizing: InpLotMode 1 = risk percent of equity at the initial stop via OrderCalcProfit (ExecCalcProfit), floored to the volume step and capped by InpMaxLots; 0 = fixed InpLots
assumptions.locks: InpMaxDailyLossPct, InpMaxDrawdownPct (persistent, manual reset only) and InpMaxConsecutiveLosses gate new entries; halting also flattens the runner when execution is enabled
assumptions.kill_switch: create InpKillSwitchFile in MQL5/Files to close the runner and stop entries until restart
assumptions.results: demo execution/backtest is an operational check, not a performance or live-readiness claim; no profit is promised
